message: Hey Jane, I really want to make sure Emily, who is a survivor of intimate partner violence, feels supported at work. Do you have any advice?
I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed with the new project deadlines. I appreciate our de-stress chats so much! They're a part of my routine now, and they help me manage my day better.
Remember to take breaks when you need, Emily. Your well-being is the most important. How about we plan a short walk during our lunch break? Fresh air could be really rejuvenating for you.
I've been trying that new meditation app before work, it really helps. The guided morning meditation sets a positive tone for my day.

You're doing amazing with your contributions to the team, Emily. The client was really impressed with your last presentation. Maybe you could share your preparation process with the team? It could become a part of our best practices.
Thanks, Jane. I'm just trying to stay focused and not let personal issues affect my work. Sticking to my exercise routine after work helps me clear my mind.
Let's catch up over coffee tomorrow morning, say 8 am? The usual spot. We can talk about how you're managing your workload and discuss any adjustments we can make.
That sounds perfect. It's been a tough week, and I could use a friend. Plus, I find that starting the day with a good conversation really helps me stay positive.
You've been handling the stress so well, Emily. Proud of you! Have you continued with your journaling in the evenings? It might be good to reflect on your successes each day.
I'm trying to keep a routine, it helps me feel in control. Thanks for being there. I make sure to journal every night before bed, it helps me process the day's events and plan for the next.
